stories.title: Philippines starts identifying ferry fire victims; dozens still missing
stories.summary: Authorities in Coron began identifying bodies from a ferry fire that killed at least 35 people, with more than 50 still missing. Forensic teams are processing remains recovered from a burned-out vessel a day after the disaster.

stories.title: BRICS bloc agrees on joint declaration, sources say
stories.summary: The BRICS group agreed on a joint declaration at its Delhi summit that is expected to avoid naming any country but will condemn unilateral war by any country, four sources told Reuters. Members worked to bridge a divide between Iran and the UAE over the Gulf conflict.

stories.title: China's Xi lands in Delhi for BRICS summit, talks with Modi
stories.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping arrived in New Delhi on Saturday for the BRICS summit and bilateral talks with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, TV channels showed. The bloc is holding its annual gathering in the Indian capital this weekend.

stories.title: Explosion hits another weapons site in Bulgaria
stories.summary: An explosion caused a fire at a weapons storage site in Bulgaria on Saturday, the latest in a series of incidents at the country's munitions facilities. Damage and casualty details were not immediately available.

stories.title: Reverse-engineering of Apple's Neural Engine tops Hacker News
stories.summary: A technical deep-dive walking through the reverse engineering of Apple's Neural Engine became the top story on Hacker News, drawing heavy attention from developers and ML engineers. The analysis breaks down the AI accelerator's architecture and instruction set inside Apple silicon.

stories.title: Cowboys hint George Pickens could be hard to keep, fueling Browns 2027 talk
stories.summary: Cowboys executive Stephen Jones signalled wide receiver George Pickens could be difficult to re-sign, a development Browns beat writers flagged as potentially opening the door for Cleveland to pursue him in 2027. Cleveland hosts Jacksonville on Sunday to open its season.

stories.title: F1: Spanish GP qualifying takes centre stage at the Madring
stories.summary: Qualifying for the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix starts at 4 p.m. local time at F1's newest street circuit, the Madring, where grid position is seen as crucial given few overtaking spots. Kimi Antonelli carries a 66-point championship lead over Mercedes teammate George Russell.

stories.title: Leclerc makes big admission after Hamilton peace talks
stories.summary: Charles Leclerc made a notable admission after holding peace talks with Ferrari teammate Lewis Hamilton following their clash at Monza. The pair smoothed things over ahead of qualifying for the Spanish Grand Prix this weekend.
